description: Prompt-caching payoff for today, the last 7 days or this month, optionally for one provider or project: cache hit rate, cache read and write volumes, and a per-model breakdown, plus ESTIMATED dollars — savings (cached reads assumed ~90% cheaper than input), the write premium (assumed ~25% over input) and the net. The estimates use the scope's average input price, not each model's card. Use it to judge whether caching pays off; for general token ratios across models, use tokmeter_efficiency.

period.description: Time period to analyze: today, week, or month

name: tokmeter_cache_efficiency
